claims.statement: Livia married Octavian, the future Augustus, in 38 BCE after her divorce from Tiberius Claudius Nero. Their marriage joined the family of her sons Tiberius and Drusus with the man who would become Rome’s first emperor.
Livia marries the future Augustus: 38 BCE to 38 BCE. Year follows Store norske leksikon. No wedding location is assigned.
